//: The app (a different project, installed without the site's packages) imports legal.ts from here. Vite and esbuild read the nearest tsconfig.json of every .ts file they transform, and site/tsconfig.json extends astro/tsconfigs/strict, which only exists where the site's packages are installed. Without this file a clean install of the app fails with: failed to resolve extends astro/tsconfigs/strict. Keep it free of any extends.
